subject: Mobile Development
title: The Size of the App Economy
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Size of the App Economy usable.

hook.text: The global app economy generates over $500 billion per year in consumer spending and advertising.

buildup.text: App stores alone processed $171 billion in consumer spending in 2023.

discovery.text: Mobile apps drive more revenue than Hollywood, music, and gaming consoles combined.

twist.text: Most of this money flows to just the top 1% of apps. The rest earn almost nothing.

climax.text: The app economy is massive but ruthlessly concentrated at the very top.

punchline.text: A half-trillion-dollar market owned by the top 1%.

quiz.question: What is true about app economy revenue distribution?
options: Most revenue goes to the top 1% of apps
